title: AutoCongrats
description: This is a mod I made that automatically says a programmable phrase when you win or lose a duel in PVP!
body:
# AutoCongrats

AutoCongrats is a Minecraft mod made by 3D_Circuit, a Minecraft YouTuber, that automatically says a programmable phrase upon winning or losing a duel.

This tool was made for people who can't type "GG" fast enough, or are just too lazy. Each message can be customized to your liking and can be toggled off with /autocongrats disable.And of course, it can also be enabled, with /autocongrats enable. 

**WARNING : USE AT YOUR OWN RISK. Some servers cheat detection systems MAY flag this as macros. Please be careful while using this mod.**

## Usage

### Download
- Download the mod from the official sources (Modrinth) alongside [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api).

### Commands
`/autocongrats [disable|enable]`  Enable/disable messages.

`/autocongrats [setlose|setwin] (Your win/loss phrase)` Changes your win/loss phrase

You can toggle the config GUI with `RIGHT SHIFT`

If you have any questions or ideas, please join my [Discord server](https://discord.gg/mqnfPFqJJa) and mention me!


Thanks to [bkhr](https://applemax.me) for helping me keep the description for this project in order!
